title: Bounded twisted long-code function
statement: Let $G$ be a regular Unique Games instance with $q$ labels, and assign to each variable a real-valued function on the sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^q$ whose values lie in $[-1,1]$. For a variable and one of its neighbors, the bounded twisted long-code function is the neighbor's function evaluated after permuting its input by the permutation on that variable-neighbor pair.
caveat: The supplied snippet omits the definitions of a regular Unique Games instance and the input-permutation operation.
